issue.title: Cable length config is wrong in T2 testing

failure.body:
**Description**

All LC's in T2 tested are configured as SpineRouter.  The type of  T3 neighbors is configured as CoreRouter, e.g., https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/e17d19215571756e9304b0085c8ca17a32b6e19b/ansible/vars/topo_t2.yml#L351.
Unfortunately, there was not cable length config for the links between CoreRouter and SpindRouter. As a result,  the default cable length, i.e., 300m, is used in T2 testing.

resolution.title: [chassis] update the T3 device type in the minigraph
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Summary:
Fixes #8700

### Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [ ] Test case(new/improvement)

### Back port request
- [ ] 201911
- [ ] 202012
- [x ] 202205

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
The cable length is calculated based on the neighbor type and device type. In the T2 topology the uplink neighbor type in the minigraph is defined as CoreRouter. This causes the device to pick incorrect cable length for uplink neighbors.

Example
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/aa46167fdd09b5f973d6c39529715ad75a2a58ec/device/arista/x86_64-arista_7800r3a_36d2_lc/Arista-7800R3A-36D2-C36/0/buffers_defaults_t2.j2#L3-L9
#### How did you do it?
This PR fixes the neighbor type of uplink neighbors to be set to `RegionalHub` or `AZNGHub` to match the values defined in the buffer_default_t2.j2
#### How did you verify/test it?
generate minigraph for T2 topo
